ensures: forall q: Int :: 0 <= q && q < n ==> goal_prime(res.arr_int[q])
forall q: Int :: 0 <= q && q + 1 < n ==> res.arr_int[q] < res.arr_int[q+1]
forall p: Int :: goal_prime(p) && p <= res.arr_int[n-1] ==> p in res.arr_int

definitions:
function goal_prime(n: Int): Bool
{ n >= 2 && (forall d: Int :: 2 <= d && d < n ==> n % d != 0) }
